title: The Winepress and the Day of Vengeance
description: A dramatic vision in which the Lord comes from Edom and Bozrah wearing blood-red garments. He has trodden the winepress alone in his anger and fury, for the day of vengeance was in his heart, and the year of redemption had come. No one helped him, but his own arm brought him victory, and he declares himself mighty to save.
